I open with this question. What is social media? Social media was constructed in the late 2000s as a platform created by private firms that enabled mass communication amongst different people around the world for different matters, whether that be via video communication, for asking people out, e-through private encrypted messaging, or whether that be through online posting mechanisms. The main point is this.

Social media is not a nice, comfortable public good. Rather, it is a good made by private firms to maximize profit. It is not a good considered social welfare of its users. It is a product considered a profit motivation for both organizing and operating it.

So, how do social media platforms make money and what do they want to do to make money?
